study type: Randomized clinical trial, single-blinded, placebo-controlled trial
exposure: Labor induction with misoprostol and propranolol vs. misoprostol alone
cohort: 128 pregnant full-term primigravid women candidates for labor induction
finding: Labor induction with misoprostol and propranolol resulted in a significantly shorter induction-delivery interval and duration of the latent phase compared to misoprostol alone.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference between both groups' mode of delivery.
